name: DISC-FIN-SFT
description: DISC-FIN-SFT is a financial instruction-tuning dataset comprising instruction samples across consulting, NLP tasks, computing, and retrieval-augmented generation to enhance financial large language models.
reputation: A specialized financial instruction-tuning dataset used to improve finance-oriented LLMs, but it is not yet a broadly standardized community benchmark.
notes: Dataset designed for instruction tuning of financial LLMs with multiple expert capabilities.
